dataset_name: Freya Bank Phone-Agent Builder Synthetic Brief Dataset
purpose: Develop and evaluate a general-purpose brief-to-Freya-workflow builder; not model fine-tuning data by itself.
important_notice: These examples are original synthetic templates, not the official hackathon briefs or official public test set. Replace illustrative tool field assumptions with the supplied tools/openapi.json schema during integration.
split_policy: Split by whole brief, not by individual test case, to avoid leaking the same policy template across train and evaluation.

scoring_policy.repeated_run_reliability: For benchmark-like reliability, a case counts as reliable only if all three repeated runs pass.
scoring_policy.never_score_from_transcript_alone: Verify actual mock-bank ledger and tool results.

known_limitations: The dataset does not reproduce official hackathon scoring fixtures.
Concrete policy values and API argument names are intentionally not invented.
Before use, bind every generated tool call to actual OpenAPI operation IDs, request fields, and response schemas.
Synthetic test oracles require concrete fixture data and an executable harness.
